  ✓ brief   ✓ questions   ● draft

  test-writer — adds table-driven tests for a package and r…

❯ Purpose
    Add table-driven tests for one package at a time. Done
    when every exported function has a case in its table
    and the package's tests pass.

  Scope
    The package you were pointed at and its _test.go
    files. Leave the exported API and every other package
    alone.

  Restrictions
    Never change an expected value to make a case pass.

  Method
    Read the package, then its tests, then write the cases
    the table is missing. Run the package's tests after
    each file.

[↑↓] move
[enter] take it
[enter] refine it with a note
[R] refine the whole draft with one note
[e] edit
[d] delete
[tab] the sections or the card
[ctrl+s] write
[shift+↑] scroll the profile up
[shift+↓] scroll the profile
[esc] back

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted, not started
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✗  failed
⊘  refused: dim by you, red by a rule
[?] hide the keys
